# Paths Generated by a Query Node

**Claim.** A query node’s generated paths are the zero child’s paths extended with value $0$ at the queried coordinate, followed by the one child’s paths extended with value $1$ there.

**Proof.** By the definition of the paths generated by a tree, a query node forms exactly the concatenation of the mapped zero-child paths, each extended by the query value $0$, and the mapped one-child paths, each extended by value $1$. This is the asserted equality directly from that defining case.
